subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — priority throughput intake
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@nebula.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: I just signed up — Dedicated capacity demo request (throughput details attached)

Hi Sean,

I signed up through the self-serve demo flow this morning and selected the Dedicated capacity track. We're evaluating Redwood for a production deployment and wanted to lock a technical walkthrough — our primary need is sustained throughput and tight latency for user-facing inference. High-level targets below: 

- Sustained: ~600 QPS (512-token context)
- Burst: brief spikes up to ~2,500 QPS during batch jobs
- p95 latency target: < 150ms for 512 tokens
- Context: live chat + summarization pipeline, sensitive to latency spikes

I've attached our internal SLA requirements (SLA_Requirements.pdf) and a short ops note.

We're in PST (San Francisco). Best windows for a demo this week are Tue/Wed mornings PT. If you can include an engineer to speak to batching/autoscale behavior that would be ideal.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Sara Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
Nebula Analytics

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@nebula.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: I just signed up — Dedicated capacity demo request (throughput details attached)

Hi Sara — thanks for signing up and for the detailed targets. I got your attachment and shared it with our solutions team.

I can run a 45-minute walkthrough that covers: Dedicated capacity architecture, batching and KV/prefix caching, quantization options, and autoscale/burst behavior — then hand to Mina for the deep technical Q&A.

Can you do one of these slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 2, 9:30–10:15 AM PT
- Wed Apr 3, 10:00–10:45 AM PT

If neither works, propose two windows that fit your leadership and ops. I'll book the invite and include Mina for the technical portion.

Quick note on prep: could you forward any sample request/response sizes (avg tokens in, tokens out) and expected concurrency across endpoints? That helps us sketch a capacity ballpark ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
SDR, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.redwood.com/sean_gallagher

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@nebula.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: I just signed up — Dedicated capacity demo request (throughput details attached)

Hi Sara — glad to meet you (virtually). I can attend either slot but prefer Wed 10:00 PT so we have time to run a short throughput sketch.

A couple items I want to validate before the demo: 
- Typical payload sizes (tokens in / tokens out) — even averages are helpful
- Does Nebula expect synchronous single-token latency sensitivity, or mostly whole-completion latency tolerance?
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency) that would affect placement?

I've attached a lightweight capacity template (capacity_plan.xlsx) that shows what we'll price/size from a QPS vs token-length basis. If you can fill the two rows (avg_in_tokens, avg_out_tokens) that will make the sketch quick.

Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara@nebula.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: I just signed up — Dedicated capacity demo request (throughput details attached)

Hi Sean / Mina — thanks, and thanks for the template Mina. I filled the sheet and attached it here (see updated SLA_Requirements.pdf with a short appendix).

Wed 10:00 PT works for the team, but an exec just asked to move the time offsite to 11:15 PT — is there any chance we can shift to 11:15–12:00 PT instead? Apologies for the churn — leadership wants to join the Q&A.

If that doesn't work for Redwood I can keep the 10:00 slot and have leadership dial in for the last 10–15 minutes.

Sara

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@nebula.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: I just signed — Dedicated capacity demo request (throughput details attached)

Sara — thanks for the update and for filling the template. 11:15 PT works for us; I updated the calendar invite and included Mina and an ops note. 

Invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nebula-demo-20280403
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-6381

Agenda (45m):
- 0–10m: intro + goals (Sean)
- 10–25m: architecture & autoscale / batching (Mina)
- 25–40m: capacity sketch & QPS sizing (Mina)
- 40–45m: next steps + mutual action plan

I'll attach our internal pre-call checklist to the invite (note: we recommend running a small loadtest ahead of pilot to validate p95 under realistic token-length distributions).

See you Wed 11:15 PT — I'll send a calendar update in a minute.

Sean Gallagher
SDR, Redwood Inference
